summary: This note surveys the legends of the Enchanted Forest, a woodland near the town of Elderglen, and the local figures who recount them. It covers the silvan spirits, the Maiden of Marigold Creek, the Midnight Carnival, the Elder Oak, and the Phantom Coachman, with dated accounts from 2023. It closes by noting that the legends keep evolving with each retelling and remain central to regional folklore.
one_line: Overview of the Enchanted Forest legends near Elderglen, including silvan spirits, Marigold, the Midnight Carnival, the Elder Oak, and the Phantom Coachman.
key_facts: The townspeople of Elderglen call their local woodland the Enchanted Forest, said to be home to many myths.
Local historian Nora Hamilton says of the trees: "They're guardians, whispering the secrets of the past to those who dare to understand."
The silvan spirits, or "tree-souls", are believed to be ancient guardians of the forest and are said to be seen on moonlit nights.
Naturalist Matthew Greenfield wrote an account on October 14, 2023, describing "luminous apparitions with tender countenances".
Late in the fall of 2023, archaeologists found a locket near Marigold Creek containing golden hair and the initials 'M.B.', believed to belong to the fabled Marigold.
In legend, Marigold loved a woodsman who died in the forest, then vanished in grief; her ghost is seen weeping at the creek's edge.
Local author Aaron Whitaker said on November 1, 2023 that Marigold is a protective spirit who guides lost souls back to safety.
The Midnight Carnival appears once a year on the darkest night and is said to be run by capricious fey folk who enchant humans into joining their revelry.
Local teen Alec Robson said he stumbled upon the Midnight Carnival on December 5, 2023, and felt the forest urging him to stay.
The Elder Oak is a gnarled ancient oak at the forest's core, considered its heart; on September 29, 2023, townspeople gathered there to seek blessings.
Dr. Julia Marcus studied the Elder Oak's growth patterns through summer 2023 and called its resilience remarkable and not yet fully understood.
The Phantom Coachman is a spectral carriage with fire-eyed horses that portends significant change for those who see it.
Emma Birch said she saw the coach from her bedroom window on October 12, 2023; witnesses reportedly experienced unexpected fortunes, sudden ventures, and returning lost loves.
The note says the stories gained fresh whispers since the autumnal equinox on September 23, 2023.
